unicodeNfc.description: Normalize Unicode to NFC so equivalent code-point sequences collapse to one. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

stripInvisible.description: Remove invisible carriers: zero-width space, word joiner, BOM, variation selectors 1-14, the Tag block and the variation-selector supplement. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

stripBidi.description: Remove bidirectional embeddings, overrides and isolates. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

foldMixedScript.description: Fold Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes to ASCII inside words that mix scripts. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

normalizeWhitespace.description: Turn exotic Unicode spaces into ordinary spaces and drop trailing whitespace. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

canonicalizeJson.description: Re-emit a whole-payload JSON object or array with sorted keys. Fixed on: only true is accepted.
